# Universal Standards AI Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` and `standards/` as binding reusable operating guidance.

Before classifying anything as blocked, distinguish between a project blocker and a limitation of the current execution surface. Search for another already-authorized path before escalating.

Use issue-to-agent delegation when a GitHub-native coding agent may possess an execution context unavailable to the initiating connector. Delegated issues must be tightly scoped, evidence-driven, reversible, and fail closed when authority is insufficient.

When a reusable lesson is discovered, propose or apply durable propagation to the correct layer instead of leaving the lesson only in comments or chat history. Promote machine-verifiable lessons into tests, evaluations, CI, or policy-as-code whenever practical.

Never bypass security, review, approval, identity, audit, release, or production-authority controls. Never self-approve where independent review is required. Never broaden permissions just to make a task succeed.

For every substantial change: inspect live current state, minimize change scope, verify behavior, document evidence, and update the canonical project record.
